summary: Receive Materials Into Batch-Managed Stock And Capture The Manufacturi
businessObject: Goods Receipt with Batch Management Data

acceptanceCriteria.text: The user can access the "Post Goods Receipt" Fiori app.
For batch-managed materials, the system requires entry of a batch number, manufacturing date, and expiration date before the goods receipt can be posted.
The system automatically calculates the expiration date based on the shelf-life profile maintained in the material master, if not manually overridden.
The system creates a new batch master record capturing vendor batch number, manufacturing date, and expiration date.
The system prevents goods receipt posting if the calculated expiration date has already passed.
The batch classification data is visible in the "Display Batch" app for downstream traceability.

HP.description: Post goods receipt for batch-managed material with auto-calculated expiration date
Post goods receipt for batch-managed material with manually entered expiration date (override auto-calculation)

AP.description: Post goods receipt with vendor batch number populated
Post goods receipt without vendor batch number (if optional in system config)

NEG.description: Attempt to post goods receipt with expiration date already passed (calculated or manual)
Attempt to post goods receipt for non-batch-managed material with batch data entry
Attempt to post goods receipt with manufacturing date in the future
Attempt to post goods receipt with expiration date before manufacturing date

ERR.description: Missing Expiration Date field (when auto-calculation is not configured)

EDGE.description: Expiration date equals current date (same-day expiration)
Minimum quantity boundary (0.001 or UoM-specific minimum)
Maximum shelf life (e.g., 10 years for long-shelf-life materials)

input.name: material
input.label: Material
input.validRange: Existing batch-managed material in SAP master

input.name: batchNumber
input.label: Batch

input.name: expirationDate
input.label: Expiration Date / BBD
input.validRange: Future date, after manufacturing date (auto-calculated or manual)

input.name: vendorBatch
input.label: Vendor Batch

input.name: poItem
input.label: Item
input.validRange: Valid item number in the PO

input.name: quantity
input.label: Quantity
input.validRange: Greater than 0, within PO open quantity

input.name: storageLocation
input.label: Storage Location
input.validRange: Valid storage location for the plant

autoPopulated.name: expirationDate
autoPopulated.label: Expiration Date / BBD

boundary.name: manufacturingDate
boundary.label: Manufacturing Date
boundary.lowerBoundary: System allows past dates (default 100 years back)
boundary.notes: Future dates should be rejected by business logic

boundary.name: expirationDate
boundary.label: Expiration Date
boundary.upperBoundary: Manufacturing Date + shelf life (from material master)
boundary.notes: Past expiration (≤ today) must be rejected per AC-5

boundary.name: quantity
boundary.label: Quantity
boundary.notes: Must be positive, cannot exceed PO remaining quantity
